note: Application-level settings: sessions, login lockout, upload limits exposed to the web layer. Read at runtime by src/app.py and src/auth.py -- never a literal in code, so an administrator can change the lockout window during the demo and watch it take effect on the next request.

session.comment: cookie_secure is false because the demo runs over plain HTTP on localhost; the deployment checklist sets it true behind TLS.

login.comment: SRS FR i. The counter resets on a successful login and after reset_counter_after_minutes of no attempts, so a legitimate typo spree does not lock an operator out of a live console.

rate_limits.comment: SRS FR lxxviii and the contract's 429 behaviour. Per-username as well as per-IP so a distributed attempt against one account is still slowed.

security_headers.content_security_policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
security_headers.comment: No 'unsafe-inline' anywhere: templates must not carry inline style or script attributes. Owner of the header set is kamran; src/app.py is the single place that applies it.

pagination.comment: FR lxvii search pages. The cap keeps a hostile ?page_size=100000 from turning the search endpoint into a denial of service.

uploads.comment: The declared content type is checked against config/thresholds.json upload.supported_formats, but the real format decision is made by decoding the bytes: a .wav extension on an MP3 is a 415, not a crash.
